package protocoldef

//roost:proto package=game.protocol go_package=example.com/moba-practice/protocol/pb;pb

type BattleResult struct {
	Winner int64  `pb:"1"`
	Digest string `pb:"2"`
	Gold   int64  `pb:"3"`
	Wins   int64  `pb:"4"`
	Losses int64  `pb:"5"`
}
type BattleResults interface {
	//roost:msg id=15003 tags=push
	Result(BattleResult)
}
